newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent diesel firms on Mobil outage.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent diesel firms on Mobil outage.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent low sulphur diesel fuel differentials firmed on talk of a fire that idled a hydrotreater at Mobil's 188,000 barrel per day Joliet, Ill., refinery, traders said on Monday.
"They are having some trouble with the hydrotreater, and that's firming differentials in Chicago and the Gulf," one trader said.
A Mobil spokeswoman was not immediately available for comment, and Illinois state regulators had no information on the weekend upset.

Low sulphur diesel in Chicago firmed to bids approaching 5.0 cents a gallon over NYMEX March heating oil for February deliveries and was seen moving higher on Tuesday, traders said. High sulphur was 2.25 cents a gallon over the print in Chicago.
Group Three low sulphur diesel was talked 4.25/4.50 cents a gallon over the print, with high sulphur 2.50 cents over.
Unleaded gasoline was steady at bids 1.50 cent a gallon below NYMEX March unleaded in Chicago, and 1.50 cent a gallon over the print in Group Three.
Traders said trade was thinning in February deliveries in the Midwest markets as Chicago prepared to shift to March deliveries and the futures expiry approached.
